description: Source code for the editor palettes component of the Wesnoth game, including classes for terrain and brush palette UI elements, event handling, and rendering.

classes.name: terrain_palette
classes.description: UI component for selecting terrain types in the map editor, including scrolling, selection, and rendering of terrain icons.

classes.name: brush_bar
classes.description: UI component for selecting brush sizes in the map editor, including rendering brush icons and handling user input.

methods.name: is_invalid_terrain
methods.description: Checks if a terrain character is invalid (space or tilde).

methods.name: adjust_size
methods.description: Adjusts the size and layout of the terrain palette UI elements.

methods.name: set_dirty
methods.description: Marks the UI component as needing to be redrawn.

methods.name: scroll_down
methods.description: Scrolls the terrain list down.

methods.name: scroll_up
methods.description: Scrolls the terrain list up.

methods.name: scroll_top
methods.description: Scrolls to the top of the terrain list.

methods.name: scroll_bottom
methods.description: Scrolls to the bottom of the terrain list.

methods.name: selected_fg_terrain
methods.description: Returns the currently selected foreground terrain.

methods.name: selected_bg_terrain
methods.description: Returns the currently selected background terrain.

methods.name: select_fg_terrain
methods.description: Sets the foreground terrain selection.

methods.name: select_bg_terrain
methods.description: Sets the background terrain selection.

methods.name: get_terrain_string
methods.description: Returns a string description of a terrain, including underlying terrains.

methods.name: left_mouse_click
methods.description: Handles left mouse click events for terrain selection.

methods.name: right_mouse_click
methods.description: Handles right mouse click events for terrain selection.

methods.name: num_terrains
methods.description: Returns the number of terrains available.

methods.name: update_report
methods.description: Updates the UI report with current terrain selections.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the terrain palette UI.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles SDL events for terrain palette interaction.

methods.name: tile_selected
methods.description: Determines which terrain tile is selected based on mouse coordinates.

methods.name: adjust_size
methods.description: Adjusts the size and layout of the brush bar UI elements.

methods.name: selected_brush_size
methods.description: Returns the currently selected brush size.

methods.name: select_brush_size
methods.description: Sets the brush size selection.

methods.name: left_mouse_click
methods.description: Handles left mouse click events for brush selection.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the brush bar UI.

methods.name: selected_index
methods.description: Returns the index of the brush icon under mouse coordinates.
